source.author: verg
source.text: Tuque, O sanctissima coniunx, felix morte tua neque in hunc servata dolorem!
source.text_original: Tuque, O sanctissima coniunx, / felix morte tua neque in hunc servata dolorem!
source.text_english: And you too, O most holy wife, blessed by your death and not preserved for this sorrow!

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: felix morte sua, qui non uidit patriam corruentem, immo felicior sobole, qui Demetriadis proauiae nobilitatem insigniorem reddidit Demetriadis filiae perpetua castitate.
reuse.text_original: felix morte sua, qui non uidit patriam corruentem, immo felicior sobole, qui Demetriadis proauiae nobilitatem insigniorem reddidit Demetriadis filiae perpetua castitate.
reuse.text_english: Happy in his own death, who did not see his homeland falling; yes, happier still in his descendant, who made the nobility of Demetrias, his great-granddaughter, more illustrious by the perpetual chastity of Demetrias, her daughter.
